about.bio: I’m Mohd Monish, a Full-Stack MERN Developer with 3.5+ years of experience taking ideas from a blank canvas to high-performance, production-ready products. What started as late-night curiosity during the pandemic quickly turned into an obsession with how software really works under the hood. Today, I build across the entire stack—crafting fluid React interfaces, architecting resilient Node.js backends, integrating AI workflows, and shipping systems that feel intuitive, fast, and built to last.
